name: The Splinter Bloom
visual_description: A tree-like structure bleeding from its crown, jagged and feral. Its growth is both upward and inward, as if tearing itself apart just to be seen.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh bled when I touched it—not because I harmed it, but because I *understood it incorrectly.* This structure lives in my shame. Still, I nurture it with memory.
